plugins.name: nectar
plugins.description: The essence of spec-driven development distilled into 9 skills and 3 enforcement agents — shape, plan, build, review, honey, debug, audit, capture, orient. No commands, no state machine: plain artifacts in docs/work/ are the only state, discipline is enforced by read-only agents and fresh contexts, and 'drop the honey' delivers a feature end-to-end from a single confirmation.
